timing_origin: First captured bootstrap; user-request timestamp unavailable. Later accounting-summary publication recorded separately.

energy.scope: Gross host CPU-package and GPU-board cumulative counter difference across one verified boot. Intermediate waiting and gaps inside these monotonic endpoints are included by the hardware counters; no power interpolation or sum of overlapping jobs. Bootstrap/download interval before the first counter boundary remains unmeasured. Not wall-socket electricity. Later accounting-summary publication is a separately recorded bookkeeping operation; raw counters remain private.
